title: Affine pushforward normalization on identity representatives
statement: For commutative rings A and B, a ring map phi : B → A, an integer i, and the shared derived-category instances, there is a natural isomorphism from T_B res_phi Gamma_A H^i to H^i Rf_* on D_QCoh(Spec A), with f = Spec(phi), satisfying q_C = T_B res_phi b_(C,id) followed by d at Q(T_A C). Equivalently it satisfies the normalization equation whenever the representative isomorphism is eqToHom of an object equality. T, q and b are the concrete tilde, derived-unit and cohomology-coordinate maps of the parent module; their definition dependencies are listed in stmt_deps. Only identity representatives, not arbitrary automorphisms, are asserted.

proof.text: Obtain the normalized natural edge morphism alpha from the existence lemma. Apply the invertibility lemma to this same alpha and its normalization. The componentwise criterion for natural isomorphisms makes alpha an isomorphism; use asIso alpha, whose hom is alpha, and retain the given normalization equations.

proof_origin.place: 0AVW and 08D4; separate natural edge existence from componentwise invertibility.

lean.statement:
theorem affineTildePushforwardCohomologyNormalization_base
    (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : B →+* A) (i : ℤ) :
    ∃ d : affineDerivedCohomologyModules A i ⋙
          (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ ⋙ affinePushforwardTilde B) ≅
        (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A))).ι ⋙
          schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of B)).toRingedSpace)) i,
      ∀ C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ,
        affineTildePushforwardIdentityNormalization A B φ i d C
